scope: Static reverse source imports, semantic variant R17. No original object may be reused for an affected module. A historical union gives a conservative superset; each chosen installation must be rebuilt and reviewed on its exact graph.

mirror.mode: All historical Lean blob/path pairs named by rev-list --objects --remotes; static imports; explicit no-network Git. Duplicate identical content may be represented by its first historical path.

local_scan.mutability: Snapshot of the ten live source-only directories and production source at inspection, including superseding variants.

verification: Read-only static import extraction. No elaboration, certificate or numerical evaluation. Reports dependency invalidation, not a new successful build or a mathematical transfer.
